parent_scientific_evidence.mechanism_inference: Late-join overrides cannot recover fragments already discarded; prediction of early public endpoint importance is required.

hypothesis: Learning calibrated future public endpoint-revisit probabilities from earlier public observations (TRAIN only) lets a memory policy proactively protect relationship path endpoints before the later cross-component linking observations arrive, improving independent unseen role-composition questions under the same 144-byte limit.

mechanism.predictor: Per-retained-endpoint 8-feature logistic classifier with 8 frozen int8 parameters. Offline binary label: endpoint reappears as an endpoint of any later TRAIN public edge during the same case.
mechanism.candidate_controller: At each current public edge, enumerate the exact frozen lossless ACTION.actions successors and choose a causal 12-record memory using sum of calibrated survival probabilities over unique public retained endpoints, competing with frozen F60 next-state under pre-frozen margin. Unlike F66B, no manual scalar length^2/compression reward; teacher learns observed binary endpoint reappearance directly.
runtime_features: current incident record count of endpoint
number of short paths incident on endpoint
mechanism.train_labels: Only future public edge incidence within frozen FIT TRAIN; no task answer labels or private tags.
mechanism.fit_loss: Binary cross-entropy, exactly 3 chronological epochs, learning rate 0.02, quantize 32*weights signed-int8; frozen before first registered cohort.
